correctness.rationale: Each of the 2n triangular faces has at least one frustrated edge; counting rim and cross edge multiplicities yields F≥n+(R_a+R_b)/2. Rim frustration parity forces F≥n for even n and ≥n+1 for odd n. Equality is completely classified: two independently alternating rims give 4 states for even n; one defective rim edge per layer, with two equivalent triangle constraints, gives two states for each ordered (I,K), hence 2n² for odd n. Summing majority spin signs and correlations over I,K yields the exact M and Caa/Cab formulas, including r=0, ring wrap, n=3. Tχ is the finite-graph zero-field variance and all T→0 limits take n fixed. Independent brute enumeration n3..8 checked every listed statistic.
